title: Finite origins and ambient lower bounds from uniform level bounds
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l and b the ordinary tower base of [def-sp-twisted-pullback-tower-domain-data]. Let T be Noetherian and let K be any object in the ordinary strict-system derived category. Suppose a<=z, s<=t, and every evaluated level is bounded constructible finite-Tor with cohomological support in [a,z] and Tor interval [s,t], in the bounds sense of [lem-sp-tower-chart-admissibility]. Then at each level K has an OriginIn witness with Tor interval [s,t], and K.IsGE a. Origins are independent, with no transition condition. This uses finite-ring constructible derived comparison [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin], interval reflection [lem-exc-comparison-tor-interval], and exact level evaluation [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian].

proof.text: For each finite coefficient ring use bounded constructible finite-ring derived comparison to choose a bounded constructible etale complex and an isomorphism to the given level. Regard it as bounded below and use exact comparison compatibility to construct the actual Origin fields. Reflect the stated Tor interval along comparison. Only a proposition asserting origin existence is constructed, not data of a new definition.

For i<a each evaluated cohomology object is zero. Exact evaluation commutes with derived cohomology. Each component of the identity of the ambient cohomology system is consequently zero, by evaluation at its level; extensionality gives identity=0. Thus that cohomology system is zero. The derived t-structure characterization gives IsGE a.

    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (T : Scheme.{u})

    (∀ n : ℕ, OriginIn l E b T n K s t) ∧ K.IsGE a
